reason: The text explicitly demonstrates Yahweh's intent to help the Israelites (Hebrew people) through multiple direct statements. Yahweh tells Joshua 'See, I have given Jericho into your hand' (vayomer YHWH el Yehoshua: 'natatit beyadkha et Yericho'), and later confirms 'for Yahweh has given you the city' (ki-natan YHWH lakhem et-ha'ir). The entire narrative structure shows Yahweh providing detailed military instructions to ensure Israel's victory. The concluding statement 'And Yahweh was with Joshua and his fame was in all the land' (vayehi YHWH et-Yehoshua) further emphasizes Yahweh's active support. The conquest of Jericho is presented as a direct result of Yahweh's assistance to the people of Israel.
